name: domjet-workspace

scripts.build: npm run build -w @domjet/browser-protocol && npm run build -w @domjet/browser-storage && npm run build -w @domjet/browser-runtime && npm run build -w domjet
scripts.test: npm test -w domjet && npm test -w @domjet/browser-runtime && npm test -w @domjet/browser-storage && npm test -w @domjet/browser-protocol

description: Domjet: a lightweight embedded browser SDK for Node.js.
